findings.text: _census_rows is passed the listed_sessions set captured at line 544, before the ready-idle rows are appended at 545-563, so a ready-idle session is not excluded and gains a second census row. This is the production path, not a corner: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:449 calls directory(..., ready_idle=True) for crew directory -- the command the plan's Why cites -- and reckon/mcp_views.py:4219 does the same. An idle coordinator that has ready sections AND a settled follower is therefore listed twice, once with plan_owner/ready_idle_sections and once with settled_at/last_dispatch, and coordinator_count is inflated by one. The landed evidence fragment's claim that one session never appears twice is false on that path, while the _census_rows docstring makes the same false claim. Remedy: recompute listed_sessions after the ready-idle extend, or pass set(idle_by_session) into _census_rows as already listed.

_last_dispatch_by_session restates the dispatch-stamp rule that reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:162 _dispatch_instant already owns -- 'dispatched_at or created_at', then parse_utc -- rather than extending it. The per-session latest projection around it is new, so only the stamp precedence is duplicated; importing the helper, or moving it to a shared owner, would keep one definition of which ledger field says when a run was dispatched.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified the change against reckon/crew_run_commands.py:449 (crew directory, ready_idle=True), reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:213 (_live_sessions, which filters state == dispatching so idle census rows do not alter resolution), the MCP directory view at reckon/mcp_views.py:4219, and SessionHost.record at reckon/crew/session_host.py:368 which writes the census live_census reads.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against f2f87f2ca59c: a3fad7a3aa adds settled_at, live_census, _census_rows, _last_dispatch_by_session and the 272-line test file; d3c975a01a makes the test wait on the follower process; 48050608d3 removes one ALLOWLIST line. The census rows are appended using a listed_sessions set captured before the ready-idle rows are added, so a ready-idle session is not excluded and can be listed twice.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when names three cases; all three are asserted in tests/test_a_coordinator_with_nothing_in_flight_is_on_the_board.py (settled child keeps session and project at lines 158-171, two-host board with an idle row at 253-264, exited owner excluded at 266) and the gate at logs/gate.log records 8 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to keep a settled follower's session in the session host's census so the board lists a coordinator with no run in flight; reckon/crew/session_host.py:381-384 and reckon/crew/directory.py:564 do exactly that, with project, session, null pid, settled_at, live_node_count 0, no runs and a last_dispatch from the ledger.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest records status complete, the three commits, the gate and arm logs, the negative control and a rubric self-check; its 'one session never appears twice' claim is contradicted by the census/ready-idle path recorded under the diff verdict, but its test results are recorded rather than merely claimed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared scope is reckon/crew/session_host.py, reckon/crew/directory.py, the new test file and two docs paths; the diff touches the first three plus a granted tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py, and the docs figures directory is unused.

justifications.durability: The negative control at logs/negative-control.log restores the pid-only census filter and both added test cases fail on it (2 failed, EXIT=1), so the assertions redden on the regression they guard rather than holding whatever the code does.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate.log records '8 passed in 5.24s' with EXIT=0 over the two done-when test files and logs/negative-control.log records '2 failed in 1.85s' with EXIT=1, but the armed base arm (coordinator-armed-base.log) exits 4 with no tests collected, so the base half of the pair measures nothing.
justifications.fit: The additions follow directory.py's own row-dict idiom and local-import style at reckon/crew/directory.py:391-407, and every new name (live_census, _census_rows, _last_dispatch_by_session) states a mechanism rather than a plan item.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/session_host.py:381-384 keeps a settled child in the record with its project, session, null pid and settled_at, and reckon/crew/directory.py:564 adds those sessions to the board's coordinator list.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/session_host.py:231 live_census is the first reader of the host records (nothing else globs _state_dir for RECORD_SUFFIX), but reckon/crew/directory.py:332 restates the dispatch-stamp rule owned by reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:162 _dispatch_instant.
justifications.scope_discipline: Four of the five changed files are inside the declared fence and the fifth, tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py, is named in the coordinator's grant in reopened.json with a single allowlist line removed.
